summary: Hutchinson Municipal Airport (HUT) serves the city of Hutchinson, Kansas, located in Reno County in the south-central part of the state. The airport primarily supports general aviation, charter operations, and air cargo activity, serving as a regional gateway to a community renowned for the Kansas Cosmosphere and Space Center and the annual Kansas State Fair.

A: HUT is situated in Hutchinson, Kansas, in Reno County, approximately 50 miles northwest of Wichita in south-central Kansas.

Q: Does Hutchinson Municipal Airport offer scheduled commercial airline service?
A: The airport primarily supports general aviation, private flights, charter operations, and air cargo rather than scheduled commercial passenger service.
